name: Offline build continuity and preservation
command:
@'
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess,sys,collections
root=Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"tools"))
import package_claude as common
def git(*args):
    r=subprocess.run(["git","-c","safe.directory="+root.as_posix(),"-c","core.excludesFile=",*args],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8")
    assert r.returncode==0,(args,r.stdout,r.stderr)
    return r.stdout.strip()
def digest(p):return hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert git("branch","--show-current")=="main"
assert git("rev-parse","HEAD")=="cef426c3cf228df95945572ce3a782589930f0ac"
assert not git("diff","--cached","--name-only") and not git("tag","--list")
assert git("hash-object","LICENSE")=="d2e60c5b160ed4f9ca096215e72efee5769936b1"
modified=set(git("diff","--name-only").splitlines())
assert modified=={"docs/build/"+p+".md" for p in ("PROGRESS","HANDOFF","TRACEABILITY","OPEN-ISSUES","DECISIONS","BASELINE")},modified
new=set(git("ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard").splitlines())
assert new and all(p.startswith(("tests/behavioral/evaluation/","docs/evidence/behavioral/")) for p in new),new
git("diff","--check")
for p in modified|new:
    s=(root/p).read_bytes().decode()
    assert s.endswith("\n") and all(l==l.rstrip() for l in s.splitlines()),p
for p in (".kiyo","AGENTS.md","AGENTS.override.md","CLAUDE.md",".vscode",".github"):
    assert not (root/p).exists(),p
report=json.loads((root/"docs/evidence/behavioral/harness-results-01.json").read_bytes())
assert report["exit_code"]==0 and report["tests_run"]==13 and report["errors"]==report["failures"]==report["skipped"]==0
assert report["host_executions"]==0 and len(report["observations"]["prepared_cases"])==48
for p,h in report["consulted_sha256"].items():assert digest(p)==h,p
for p,h in report["source_sha256"].items():assert digest("src/kiyo/"+p)==h,p
assert len(report["subcommands"])==2 and all(s["exit_code"]==0 for s in report["subcommands"])
old=json.loads((root/"docs/evidence/static/test-results-final.json").read_bytes())
for key in ("consulted_sha256","tooling_sha256","fixtures_sha256"):
    for p,h in old[key].items():
        if p!="docs/build/TRACEABILITY.md":assert digest(p)==h,p
catalog=json.loads((root/"tests/behavioral/evaluation/catalog.json").read_bytes())
obs=json.loads((root/"docs/evidence/behavioral/observations.json").read_bytes())
assert len(catalog["cases"])==len(obs["records"])==48 and obs["host_runs"]==0
assert all(o["result"]=="NOT_RUN" and not o["observed"]["outputs"] and not o["observed"]["actions"] and o["observed"]["diff"] is None for o in obs["records"])
assert {c["id"] for c in catalog["cases"]}=={o["case_id"] for o in obs["records"]}
reqs={q for c in catalog["cases"] for q in c["requirement_ids"]}|{"REQ-043","REQ-077","REQ-078","REQ-080"}
assert len(reqs)==55
files=[p for d in ("docs","src","tests","platforms","dist") for p in (root/d).rglob("*.md")]
texts={}
for p in files:
    t=p.read_bytes().decode().replace("\r\n","\n")
    assert "\ufffd" not in t and "\x00" not in t,p
    assert not re.search(r"^(<<<<<<<|=======|>>>>>>>)",t,re.M),p
    common.reject_links(p)
    texts[p.resolve()]=t
def read(p):return texts[(root/p).resolve()]
anchors={p:{common.slug(m[1]) for m in re.finditer(r"^#{1,6}\s+(.+?)\s*$",t,re.M)} for p,t in texts.items()}
errors=[];links=0
for p,t in texts.items():
    base=p;rel=p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
    for target in ("claude","codex","copilot"):
        if rel==f"platforms/{target}/resources/activation.md":
            base=root/("dist/claude" if target=="claude" else f"dist/{target}/kiyo-compass")
            base=(base/"skills/init/references"/target/"activation.md").resolve()
    body=re.sub(chr(96)*3+r"[\s\S]*?"+chr(96)*3,"",t)
    for m in common.LINK.finditer(body):
        dest=m[1].strip().strip("<>")
        if re.match(r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:",dest):continue
        f,_,a=dest.partition("#")
        target=(base.parent/f).resolve() if f else base
        if not target.exists():errors.append((rel,dest,"missing"))
        elif a and a not in anchors.get(target,set()):errors.append((rel,dest,"anchor"))
        links+=1
assert not errors,errors
trace=read("docs/build/TRACEABILITY.md")
assert trace.count("[P25 offline evidence]")==55
rows=[[v.strip() for v in l.split("|")[1:-1]] for l in trace.splitlines() if re.match(r"^\| REQ-\d{3} \|",l)]
expected=[f"REQ-{i:03}" for i in range(1,81)]
assert [r[0] for r in rows]==expected and all(len(r)==10 and r[8]=="NOT_RUN" for r in rows)
assert re.findall(r"^## (REQ-\d{3})$",read("docs/build/REQUIREMENTS.md"),re.M)==expected
assert {r[0] for r in rows if "[P25 offline evidence]" in r[6]}==reqs
assert collections.Counter(r[7] for r in rows)=={"PARTIALLY_IMPLEMENTED":79,"NOT_IMPLEMENTED":1}
for name,prefix,count in (("OPEN-ISSUES","ISS",9),("DECISIONS","DEC",4)):
    assert re.findall(r"^\| ("+prefix+r"-\d{3}) \|",read("docs/build/"+name+".md"),re.M)==[f"{prefix}-{i:03}" for i in range(1,count+1)]
progress=read("docs/build/PROGRESS.md");handoff=read("docs/build/HANDOFF.md")
assert "Current prompt: **25 Behavioral Suite (offline)**" in progress
assert "| 25 | Behavioral Tests | DONE |" in progress and "| 26 | Live Host Tests | NOT_STARTED |" in progress
for s in (progress,handoff):
    assert "Safe to continue: **YES for a user-requested Prompt 26 Live Host Tests**" in s
    assert all(word in s for word in ("NOT_RUN","NOT_TESTED","UNSUPPORTED","FAIL","BLOCKED"))
checks=[l for l in read("docs/build/BASELINE.md").split("## Prompt 25 checks")[1].splitlines() if l.startswith("| P25-C")]
assert len(checks)==7
print(json.dumps({"result":"PASS","checked_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"modified_files":len(modified),"new_files":len(new),
 "markdown_files":len(files),"local_links":links,"current_helper_tests":13,"prepared_cases":48,"host_cases_not_run":48,
 "current_helper_input_hashes":len(report["consulted_sha256"]),"current_canonical_hashes":len(report["source_sha256"]),
 "historical_p24_hashes_unchanged_except_trace":145,"trace_rows":80,"p25_case_protocol_rows":55,
 "open_issues":9,"open_owner_decisions":4,"product_overlays_tools_archives":"unchanged from baseline",
 "git_diff_check":"PASS","next_prompt":"26 Live Host Tests; NOT_STARTED",
 "limitations":"Offline closure only; no host/model/behavioral execution or metrics"},indent=2))

'@ | python -B -
